_about: Home equipment and the gym -> home swap table read by the Friday make-up job (scripts/review/weekend_makeup.py, rule `weekend-makeup`). Keys under `swaps` are the gym exercise as the block names it, or its Hevy template title; both resolve through scripts/hevy/exercise_map.py. Every owed exercise goes in the make-up (FB 2026-11-08). One with no entry here, Big-5 included, goes in as written; `as_written: true` does the same with a note. When he logs a home alternative for an as-written line, add it here as the swap.
_source: Athlete, 2026-10-17: dumbbells 5-50 lb, a bench, bands. No barbell, no machines.

equipment._dumbbell_step_note: Assumed. Correct it here if the set jumps differently; loads snap DOWN onto this grid.

_classes.priority: Load-bearing shoulder work. Made up first.
_classes.standard: Cheap, nothing the next Monday depends on.
_classes.saturday-only: Chest/triceps and legs. Done Sunday they pre-tire Monday's bench or squat (accessory-day-interference). Big-5 and barbell secondaries with no swap land here too.
_classes.core: Low cost; fills the routine last.

_load_modes.plan: Same implement as the gym: the plan's load for that week.
_load_modes.log: Median of the last 3 logged sessions of the HOME exercise (loads-from-logs); `default_lb` only when there is no history in the last year.
_load_modes.as_written: `as_written: true`: the gym exercise as the block writes it, at the plan's load, not snapped to the dumbbell rack. He improvises at home.

Reverse Pec Deck.note: Chest down on the inclined bench, or seated with your chest on your thighs. No standing hinge while the back is under treatment. Cuff work for the torn anterior tendons, so the @7 cap stands.

Face Pull.note: Band at chest height, squeeze the shoulder blades, slow on the way back. Same job as the face pull.

Chest Supported Incline Row.note: Chest on the bench, inclined or flat. Never bent-over: the back rule holds at home too.

Iso-Lateral Row (Machine).note: Chest on the bench, one arm at a time if you like. Never bent-over.

Chest Fly (Machine).note: Lie on the FLOOR, not the bench. The floor stops your elbows level with your torso, which is the shoulder rule (subscapularis tear) built in.

Tricep Pushdown.note: Kickback, not an overhead extension: overhead is the bursitis pattern. First time at home, so let the RPE set the load; the log anchors it from next time.

Pallof Press.note: Band anchored at chest height. Slow out, hold a beat, slow in.

Single Arm Landmine Press (Barbell).note: No landmine at home. If you improvise with a dumbbell, keep it angled (half-kneeling, pressing up and forward, not overhead) and stop at @7: the DB press is the one that kept running to @10. Log it under what you did.

Lat Pulldown.note: Band anchored high (door anchor), kneeling. Hands wider than shoulders, palms forward, the same grip as the gym for the elbows. Never neutral.

Seated Calf Raise.note: Optional, your call (FB 2026-11-08): the gym bans standing calf raises while the back is under treatment, but here it's one dumbbell in one hand, not load on the spine. Ball of the foot on a step, free hand on the wall, full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top. Back says no, skip it.

Leg Extension (Machine).note: Hold a door frame, knees forward, heels up, lean back as you go. Bodyweight first; hold a dumbbell to your chest only when 12 is easy. Quads without loading the back.

Seated Leg Curl.note: No dumbbell leg curl at home. Ideas: sliding leg curls on socks or a towel (hips up), or a band-assisted Nordic. Never a loaded hinge (back). Log it under what you did.

Hip Thrust (Smith Machine).note: Shoulders on the bench, dumbbell on the working hip, one leg at a time. Single leg because a 50 lb dumbbell is too light for two.

Bulgarian Split Squat.note: Same exercise as the gym, rear foot on the bench, dumbbells at your sides.
